thread:
annie_support: Customer on Dedicated spotted all per-model throughput lines collapsed to 0 in Console (only overall cluster QPS shows). They filed an incident, says it started ~02:10 UTC after a deploy. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/example.png

caleb_platform: Got the screenshot, thanks. Any error logs from the metrics exporter or platform around 02:00-02:20?

annie_support: Pasting customer timeline: they saw normal QPS until 02:07, then dashboards show flatlines. No API errors reported, just the graphs. I'll attach the support bundle they uploaded in the ticket.

priya_oncall: I'm looking at the metrics stream. Can you dump a sample metric name/labels for redwood_inference_qps? I suspect the label change we rolled last night.

caleb_platform: quick sample from the exporter at 01:58 (pre-deploy):
```
redwood_inference_qps{model_id="gptx-4-mini",instance="gpu-42",region="us-west-2"} 12.3
```
And from 02:12 (post-deploy):
```
redwood_inference_qps{model="gptx-4-mini",instance="gpu-42",region="us-west-2"} 12.1
```
So exporter rename: `model_id` -> `model`.

lucy_sre: That'll break any dashboards that `by (model_id)` or use the `model_id` template var. Grafana will group by label that no longer exists -> panels show one series or nothing.

mike_product: Do we know which dashboards/panels are impacted? Is this only Console per-model throughput or other things too?

caleb_platform: Initial sweep: Console per-model throughput, per-model latency sparklines, and the per-model cost breakdown panels. Anything that expects `model_id` label is affected. Cluster-level aggregates (no label) unaffected.

priya_oncall: Quick mitigation options:
1) Re-add compatibility label at scrape time (metric_relabel_configs) to copy `model` -> `model_id` on the metrics pipeline, hotfixing dashboards without changing them.
2) Update Grafana queries/templating to use a neutral label (e.g., `label_replace` to coalesce `model` and `model_id` into `model_key`).
Which is faster? 1 is fastest to restore user-facing dashboards.

caleb_platform: I'll prepare a hotfix to metrics pipeline to restore `model_id` for now. Patch: add in Prometheus remote write processing or exporter relabeling: 
```yaml
metric_relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [model]
    target_label: model_id
    action: replace
```
Deploying to metrics staging first.

deploy-bot: deploy started for metrics-pipeline-hotfix #1593 at 2050001248 by caleb_platform

lucy_sre: Also let's update dashboards to be tolerant long-term. Example Panel query we can switch to: 
```
label_replace(redwood_inference_qps, "model_key", "$1", "model", "(.+)")
 +
label_replace(redwood_inference_qps, "model_key", "$1", "model_id", "(.+)")
```
Then `sum by (model_key) (rate(redwood_inference_qps[5m]))`

annie_support: Customer informed and flagged as P2. They asked for ETA to see graphs back.

deploy-bot: deploy completed at 2050001254, all metrics-pipeline instances reported healthy.

priya_oncall: I can see the per-model series repopulating now. Grafana panels in console show normal lines again for the customer (checked their org).

mike_product: Great. Root cause summary for ticket: exporter refactor renamed label `model_id` -> `model` without a compatibility layer; dashboards referenced `model_id` -> panels lost per-model grouping.

caleb_platform: Action items:
- (P0) Hotfix applied to metrics pipeline to copy `model` -> `model_id` (done).
- (P1) Update all Console dashboards to use `model_key` via label_replace and ship a universal dashboard patch (owner: caleb_platform).
- (P1) Add CI check for metric label renames on PRs and require compatibility shim.
- (P2) Postmortem and notify customers that saw impact.

lucy_sre: Also forwarding to infra-metrics for a longer-term story: recording rule to normalize labels upstream so consumers don't need to chase exporter changes.

annie_support: Customer replied: "Thanks, graphs back, appreciate the quick fix." Closing the case once PM signs off on follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

mike_product: I'll own the customer follow-up note and the PM side of the postmortem.

caleb_platform: Will open PRs to update dashboards and add the exporter compatibility test today.

priya_oncall: Marking oncall resolved, will keep alert thresholds on watch for 24h.

annie_support: Closing thread for internal discussion. Will post postmortem link when ready. :eyes:
